messages:
alex_w: Heads-up - a few partners have surfaced the same ask: let partners resell via sub-tenants, move unused commit between tenants, and lower embedded pricing for end-customer volumes. We need a crisp product + legal playbook. Thoughts?

maya: Quick clarification - by "move unused commit" do they mean unlimited transfer or scheduled reallocation?

jordan_m: They want flexibility. Concrete from BetaPartner: a pool of commit that can be rebalanced monthly across up to 50 sub-tenants, and a 12-18mo shelf-life so unused commit doesn't evaporate too fast.

samir: From an infra POV we can support: per-tenant usages, a pooled-commit construct, and a transfer API that enforces admin permissions + rate limits. Transfer semantics: atomic move of credits or scheduled rebalance job.

liz_s: Legal: resale changes our risk profile. Need a reseller DPA addendum, indemnities for misuse, export control gating for specific geos, and an audit clause. Also prob want to ban model re-training/weight export.

alex_w: Product sketch (MVP):
- Pooled commit object (pool_id) with owner=partner, balance, expiry_date
- Sub-tenant resources: tenant_id with usage counters and tags for billing
- Transfer API: POST /pools/{id}/transfer {from_tenant, to_tenant, amount, scheduled_at?}
- Rebalance job: optional cron-based move respecting policy (min-retain, approved-list)
- Billing CSV: include pool_id, tenant_id, token_usage, overage flags
- Admin toggle in Console to enable reseller-mode per partner

maya: UX notes: need partner-admin console for creating tenants, scheduling rebalance, and viewing audit trail. Also separate onboarding flow to collect partner contacts + compliance docs. Est: PM 4d, design 3d, eng 2 sprints (one spike + MVP).

jordan_m: Pricing approaches:
- Option 1: % discount off public list for all resold tokens (simple)
- Option 2: Commit-pack pricing with tiered per-token reduction as volumes increase (more predictable margins)
- Option 3: Time-bound credits (long shelf-life) with higher discount but no refunds (reduces churn risk)
I prefer commit-pack + volume tiers for margin control. Will model a few scenarios.

samir: Technical constraints:
- Enforce quotas across Hosted/Dedicated/Private: Hosted enforced centrally; Dedicated can get managed config + controller; Private is opt-in with self-billing flag.
- Transfers must be idempotent and logged to a tamper-evident audit stream (for disputes).
- Consider transfer cooldown (e.g., 1/day) to prevent billing arbitrage.

liz_s: Legal asks to product/ops:
- Control to disable resale per partner
- Geo allowlist for partners who can resell (export controls)
- Data handling: define whether sub-tenants are treated as our customers or partner customers for privacy law (affects breach obligations)
- Sample clause: "Partner shall not access raw model weights or internal-only APIs; any derivative model training is prohibited."

ops-bot: Note: compliance checklist flagged - need SOC2 status, export control questionnaire, and reseller KYC docs before pilot.

alex_w: Suggested launch criteria (pilot):
- Working pooled-commit + transfer API in Hosted
- Console partner-admin flows for tenant creation + audit view
- Billing line items and export for partner-finance (CSV + invoice mapping)
- Legal template (reseller addendum + DPA) reviewed by counsel
- E2E test plan: create pool, assign tenants, move credits, trigger overage, validate CSV mapping
- Security review and logging SLA (30d audit retention min)

maya: Action list:
- maya: create GH issue with acceptance criteria + wireframes (ETA 3d)
- samir: spike transfer API + audit stream (ETA 4d)
- jordan_m: run pricing P&L scenarios and recommended banding (ETA EOW)
- liz_s: draft reseller addendum + geo clause (ETA EOW)
- ops-bot: start compliance intake for two pilot partners

jordan_m: Also will prepare a sample commercial appendix with: sample invoice, mapping of pool->tenant charges, example overage calc at 70% of public rate for pilot.

samir: One more engineering flag: consider tagging tokens generated via resold flows so we can do partial throttling or tracebacks in abuse cases. Adds ~2d.

alex_w: Good call. Let's aim to have spike + legal draft by next Wed and pick one pilot partner. Sync Fri to review progress. :white_check_mark:
